## 📌 Description
Enable parallel test execution using TestNG, support Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit simultaneously, and ensure thread safety.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **TestNG Parallel Configuration**
- `testng.xml` – `<suite name="..." parallel="tests" thread-count="3">`
- Ensure each thread gets its own Playwright browser instance

- [ ] **Thread‑Safe Browser Factory**
- Replace singleton with `ThreadLocal<Playwright>`, `ThreadLocal<Browser>`
- Close resources in `@AfterMethod` (or `@AfterClass`)

- [ ] **Cross‑Browser Matrix**
- Parameterise test execution via `mvn test -Dbrowsers=chromium,firefox,webkit`
- Generate separate reports for each browser

- [ ] **CI Matrix Strategy**
- GitHub Actions matrix strategy for browser/OS combinations
- Aggregate results and upload combined report

- [ ] **Stability Improvements**
- Increase timeouts for slower browsers (WebKit)
- Automatic retry of failed tests (single retry) – full retry analyzer later

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All existing tests pass in parallel on all three browser engines
- [ ] Execution time is significantly lower than sequential (≥2x speedup)
- [ ] No cross‑thread contamination (e.g., shared state in static variables)

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] v0.6.0 (Visual Regression) stable

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] Run `mvn test -Dbrowsers=chromium,firefox` – both succeed
- [ ] TestNG report shows separate instances per browser
- [ ] `pom-validator.sh` marks v0.7.0 requirements as satisfied
